name: How long does basement flooring installation usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does basement flooring installation usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation timeline typically ranges from one to four days, depending on the floor material and concrete condition. Floating floors like luxury vinyl plank or laminate can often be laid in one to two days for an average-sized basement. Tile installations require three to four days or more to account for laying tile, curing thin-set mortar, grouting, and sealing. Subfloor preparation—such as grinding uneven high spots, filling cracks, or applying self-leveling underlayment—adds extra time before any finished flooring can go down.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most basement installations take one to four days. Floating vinyl plank takes one to two days, while tile requires several days for mortar and grout to cure.
